Liver-injury screening scatter (eDISH / mDISH / cholestatic)

Source: R/plot_edish.R
plot_edish.Rd

Default hepatocellular eDISH is one log-log panel colored by treatment so arm imbalance is visible. Quadrant names are annotated in the corners. Open red circles mark biochemical potential Hy's Law (bilirubin in the concurrent window after ALT/AST elevation, with optional ALP exclusion). Axis maxima are not required to occur on the same day.

Usage

plot_edish(
  adsl = NULL,
  adlb = NULL,
  classified = NULL,
  which = c("edish", "mdish", "cholestatic"),
  color_by = c("arm", "quadrant"),
  log_axes = TRUE,
  facet = FALSE,
  annotate_quadrants = TRUE,
  mark_potential = TRUE,
  title = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

adsl, adlb

Passed to classify_hyslaw() when classified is NULL.

classified

Optional list from classify_hyslaw().

which

"edish" is peak ALT or AST / ULN vs peak BILI / ULN; "mdish" uses peak / baseline; "cholestatic" is peak ALP / ULN vs peak BILI / ULN.

color_by

"arm" colors points by the grouping variable (default, for treatment imbalance). "quadrant" colors by screening quadrant.

log_axes

If TRUE, both axes use log10 scales.

facet

If TRUE, facet by the grouping variable when it has at least two levels. Default FALSE keeps arms on one panel.

annotate_quadrants

If TRUE, print quadrant names in the corners.

mark_potential

If TRUE, overlay open red circles on biochemical potential Hy's Law (eDISH / mDISH) or concurrent cholestatic cases.

title

Plot title. Generated from which when NULL.

...

Passed to classify_hyslaw().

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

data <- make_synthetic_hyslaw_data(n_extra = 0L, seed = 1L)
plot_edish(data$ADSL, data$ADLB)

plot_edish(data$ADSL, data$ADLB, which = "cholestatic")
